name: vscode-eslint
description: Integrates ESLint JavaScript into VS Code.
readme:
# ESLint

Lints JavaScript and TypeScript with the ESLint installed in your project (`node_modules/eslint`): diagnostics as you type, quick fixes per rule, and `source.fixAll.eslint` for fix-on-save via `editor.codeActionsOnSave`.

The extension does not bundle ESLint itself — install it in your workspace (`npm install eslint`) and add an `eslint.config.*` file.

This is the unmodified extension published on Open VSX, pinned to a specific version and verified to work in Diode.
